output.summary: A grey-leaved perennial herb native to Europe, northern Africa, and southwestern and central Asia, white horehound has crinkled, downy leaves and clusters of white flowers high on the stem. Its extract flavors bittersweet hard candies, while the plant is also used in horehound beer, herbal tea and cocktails.
